purpose: Maps the dataset's PII type names to the categories Blackout detects. Used only by tests/convert-gretel.py to build a test file. Nothing here trains a model.

excluded.company: Blackout does not target organisation names. Detections that fall on these spans are tallied separately, not counted as false positives.
excluded.date: Generic dates are not sensitive on their own. Only dates of birth are targeted.

notes: The dataset's own card says its labels came from an NER model plus an LLM judge and may contain false positives and negatives, so the converter checks every span and moves doubtful ones out of scoring instead of trusting them.
The 'name' type is far more frequent than first_name and last_name and can include non-person names, so name spans that look like organisations are set aside.
Only the English documents are converted. The other languages (Spanish, Swedish, German, Italian, Dutch, French) are outside the scope of Blackout's rules.
The dataset has no Indian identifiers (PAN, Aadhaar); those are covered by the hand-authored tests/data/indian-ids.jsonl.
